name: Perfect Match
source:
A young man/woman believes that they meet their ideal partner through a dating service, but soon come to realize everything is not as it seems.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Perfect_Match]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻男女相信他们通过约会服务遇到了理想的伴侣，但很快就意识到一切并不像看上去的那样。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Perfect_Match]Choices Wikia[/url]]
